value: An alias wins in resolveKey: a name that is both an alias and an entry resolves to the alias target. Since #292 (#279) no write can create that pair — alias set/rename, set -a, rename --set-alias, MCP and import all refuse an alias named after an existing entry in either store (INVALID_INPUT, case and filesystem folding included) — and `run` gates the name as typed as well as every alias target, so a pair cannot carry a run past a flag. Pairs stored by 1.3.0 still resolve to the alias. Still open (#291): an entry can be created under an existing alias's name, and importing a 1.3.0 export that holds such a pair after `data reset` is refused.
